smuggler.note: Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2.5, regenerated without the concept's jetpack from a front render of the first smuggler (generation f4839e2f-b491-45f1-b8d3-d8ee39578fe1), rigged with the human template (242ce4d4-86cf-4c17-bc91-dd216a49d858). remnant_guard.note: Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2.5 from the Remnant guard concept sheet (front, side and back views; generation bb20d76d-1ba1-45d2-b074-815c90d36dbb), rigged with the human template (26696d50-eca2-4dee-a950-4597709af23e). Worn by every Remnant archetype.
